description: This file implements RPC client and server logic for database operations within the Mattermost plugin system, including connection management, transaction handling, statement execution, and result set processing.

classes.name: dbRPCClient
classes.description: Client-side logic for handling RPC communication with the database server.

classes.name: dbRPCServer
classes.description: Server-side component responsible for calling driver methods and encoding responses.

methods.name: Conn
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database, returning a connection string and error.

methods.name: ConnPing
methods.description: Pings the connection identified by connID.

methods.name: ConnClose
methods.description: Closes the connection identified by connID.

methods.name: Tx
methods.description: Begins a transaction with specified options, returning a transaction ID and error.

methods.name: TxCommit
methods.description: Commits the transaction identified by txID.

methods.name: TxRollback
methods.description: Rolls back the transaction identified by txID.

methods.name: Stmt
methods.description: Prepares a statement for a connection, returning a statement ID and error.

methods.name: StmtClose
methods.description: Closes the statement identified by stID.

methods.name: StmtNumInput
methods.description: Returns the number of input parameters for the statement.

methods.name: StmtQuery
methods.description: Executes a query statement with given arguments, returning a statement ID and error.

methods.name: StmtExec
methods.description: Executes a statement with arguments, returning a ResultContainer and error.

methods.name: ConnQuery
methods.description: Executes a query on a specific connection with arguments, returning a string and error.

methods.name: ConnExec
methods.description: Executes a command on a connection with arguments, returning a ResultContainer and error.

methods.name: RowsColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column names for a result set.

methods.name: RowsClose
methods.description: Closes the result set identified by resID.

methods.name: RowsNext
methods.description: Advances to the next row in the result set, copying data into dest.

methods.name: RowsHasNextResultSet
methods.description: Checks if there is a next result set.

methods.name: RowsNextResultSet
methods.description: Moves to the next result set.

methods.name: RowsColumnTypeDatabaseTypeName
methods.description: Returns the database type name of a column.

methods.name: RowsColumnTypePrecisionScale
methods.description: Returns precision, scale, and if the column is nullable for a column.
